name: Setup Steps
summary: A three-card onboarding section on gradient art: a keycap grid of connected tools, a list of toggleable checks, and a summary brief card, each with a staggered scroll entrance.
useWhen: A landing page explains how onboarding works in three short steps with a visual each
The steps are 'connect', 'configure', 'get your first result'
avoidWhen: Steps are many or need a long timeline; use a changelog or timeline component
A single feature needs a large visual; use marketing/phone-split-feature
